```{=html}
<div id="matter-adiabatic-lab" class="matter-lab adiabatic-lab">
  <div class="matter-lab-controls">
    <label>Потенциал в начале \(A_0\)
      <span><output data-out="A0">5.5</output></span>
      <input data-control="A0" type="range" min="0.2" max="8" step="0.05" value="5.5">
    </label>
    <label>Длина профиля \(X\Delta\)
      <span><output data-out="T">55</output></span>
      <input data-control="T" type="range" min="1" max="120" step="0.5" value="55">
    </label>
    <label>Вакуумный угол \(\theta\)
      <span><output data-out="theta">33.4</output>°</span>
      <input data-control="theta" type="range" min="3" max="44" step="0.1" value="33.4">
    </label>
    <div class="matter-presets" role="group" aria-label="Скорость профиля">
      <button type="button" data-preset="slow">адиабатично</button>
      <button type="button" data-preset="fast">быстро</button>
      <button type="button" data-preset="smallmix">малый \(\theta\)</button>
      <button type="button" data-action="play">▶ пройти профиль</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="matter-lab-readouts">
    <div><span>\(\eta_{\max}\)</span><b data-val="eta">—</b></div>
    <div><span>\(\min\Delta_m/\Delta\)</span><b data-val="gap">—</b></div>
    <div><span>\(P_{2m}\) на выходе</span><b data-val="P2m">—</b></div>
    <div><span>\(P_{2}\) на выходе</span><b data-val="P2">—</b></div>
    <div class="prob"><span>\(P_{e}\) на выходе</span><b data-val="Pe">—</b></div>
  </div>
  <div class="adiabatic-progress"><i data-progress></i></div>
  <div class="matter-lab-plots">
    <figure>
      <svg data-plot="profile" viewBox="0 0 610 285" role="img" aria-label="Профиль плотности и вероятности в трёх базисах"></svg>
      <figcaption><span class="l13-key" style="--key: var(--matter-red)"></span>\(P_e\)
        <span class="l13-key" style="--key: var(--matter-blue)"></span>\(P_2\)
        <span class="l13-key" style="--key: var(--matter-gold)"></span>\(P_{2m}\)
        <span class="l13-key l13-key--dash" style="--key: var(--matter-blue)"></span>\(P_2\) при следовании
        <span class="l13-key l13-key--wide" style="--key: rgba(200,214,228,.45)"></span>\(A/A_0\)</figcaption>
    </figure>
    <figure>
      <svg data-plot="branches" viewBox="0 0 440 285" role="img" aria-label="Заселённость мгновенных ветвей"></svg>
      <figcaption>уровни \(\pm\Delta_m/2\):
        <span class="l13-dot" style="--key: var(--matter-gold)"></span>\(P_{2m}\)
        <span class="l13-dot" style="--key: var(--matter-purple)"></span>\(P_{1m}\)</figcaption>
    </figure>
  </div>
</div>
```
